units_note: Positions/bounds are arbitrary scene units on a flat plane for the fixed cinematic camera; exact numbers get pinned when layout rendering runs. No sim or economics values live here — presentation + content references only.

slots.note: Berth-queue state IS observable slice1 sim state (ship waiting / unloader busy) — approved exception keeping cards as pure projections.

preview.learning_line: Scrap is graded: clean bushing gives the best yield; shredded scrap forces blending with DRI to dilute copper and tin.
A DRP reduces ore to DRI continuously — it never stops, so downstream storage decides whether the EAF ever starves.
A DRP discharges continuously; this slot holds its output so the EAF never starves.

preview.learning_line: Billets cool and wait here; the mill eats from its own stock, so this yard is what keeps the rolls fed between casts.
